summaries.en: yt-dlp is a powerful command-line tool that solves the practical problem of downloading videos and audio from thousands of websites when you need offline access or want to archive content. It works by intelligently extracting media streams through extensive site-specific extractors and can merge multiple formats while supporting post-processing filters. You can use it via simple commands to download specific quality formats, extract audio only, or integrate it into scripts for batch processing your favorite educational or entertainment content.
summaries.zh: yt-dlp 是一款功能强大的命令行音视频下载工具，能够从数千个网站下载媒体内容，解决用户需要离线访问或保存网络视频的实际需求。它通过精心设计的站点提取器架构智能解析不同平台的媒体流，支持自动合并视频与音频轨道，并可应用后处理滤镜优化输出质量。用户只需简单命令即可下载指定画质的视频、提取纯音频文件，或将其集成到自动化脚本中批量处理教学资料、技术讲座等有价值内容，非常适合媒体收藏和内容分析场景。
